title: Stratification of moduli spaces of instantons on the Segre product of three lines via 't Hooft bundles
summary: Let $X$ be the Segre product of three projective lines. For a fixed effective divisor $D$ on $X$, we introduce the notions of $D$-'t Hooft, $(D_i,D_j)$-special and $D$-sectional special bundle. The varieties parameterizing these bundles yield a natural stratification of the moduli space of stable instanton bundles with fixed Chern classes. After characterizing the curves associated with these bundles via Serre correspondence, we describe the corresponding Hilbert schemes.
